text:
Rae (People Ops): Quick share 1 compact feedback & goal micro-templates for managers. Goal: make self-reviews + handoffs go in <5 minutes. Please glance.

Noah (Eng Manager): skimmed. can we force a primary metric line and a single success sentence? keeps reviews focused.

Rae (People Ops): done 1 primary success metric + one-sentence success criteria. also added a short 'why this matters' prompt.

Zara (IC): add a small 'expected time per week' so I can see bandwidth before committing.

Rae (People Ops): added "Est. weekly focus" as an optional line. default examples: 10%, 25%, 50%.

Ben (Product): for exploratory goals, suggest using a "decision doc" metric (ship doc + decision).

Rae (People Ops): included three patterns: deliverable shipped, learning milestone, decision gate. examples in the template.

NotifyBot: Resource update scheduled 1 templates will appear in the Knowledge Hub within 24 hours.

Noah (Eng Manager): what about peer feedback prompts? need 30-second prompts.

Rae (People Ops): micro-peer prompts (3 bullets): 1) one-line observed outcome, 2) one suggestion to amplify impact, 3) one small offer to help next quarter. Optional: "one thing to stop" for calibration.

Zara (IC): looks good. can you add a manager quick-accept checklist (3 yes/no)?

Rae (People Ops): added: outcome-oriented? measurable or defined milestone? owners clear? Yes/No ticks.

Noah (Eng Manager): please drop a TL;DR paste block for calendar invites. i'll trial it this week.

Rae (People Ops): TL;DR paste block included. Uploading files to #docs and tagging managers. Thanks for the quick review!
